fix_note: The Substrate grid auto-fired every probe on mount — including six cards whose macro is a mutating operator verb run as a dry run (sync.force, scope.promote, swarm.run, harness.run, heartbeat.tick, evolution.dedupe) — presented as live diagnostics to any viewer of the System lens, and those are the cards that sat at 'probing…'. The six are now flagged operatorAction in the probe registry: their cards render a gated 'operator action — not probed' state, the query is disabled, and re-probe is disabled, while the 17 read probes probe and resolve as before. The tab blurb now says operator actions are listed but never run from the grid. Matches operator-console practice (AWS/Vercel): a status grid never executes mutating operations on page load (GB-1496). [Re-recorded 2026-11-13 by zuko-desk: this row was dropped from fix_tickets.jsonl by 5b9e27c43; fix is on the branch at bb27496f9.]

Post history (the timeline axis) labelled every event with the author's raw UUID — the page's event mapping set label to the author id, against the lens's own S-TL-4 rule that surfaces show a resolved display name or a neutral label, never the raw id. Each axis label is now the post itself (its opening text, or '(media post)'), and the detail line carries the author by display name (or 'Member') plus the post excerpt. Matches the PostCard convention in the same lens (GB-1496). [Re-recorded 2026-11-13 by zuko-desk: this row was dropped from fix_tickets.jsonl by 5b9e27c43; fix is on the branch at 617138810.]
